# JSG Construction Limited

> Residential master builders in Dublin, Ireland. Home extensions, full
> renovations and structural steel, built by an in-house crew under RIAI
> contracts and BCAR.

Contact: commercial@jsgconstruction.ie
Areas served: Dublin city and county, Kildare, Wicklow.
Site visits: Monday to Friday.

## What the company does

- House extensions. Single and two-storey rear extensions.
- Full renovations. Back-to-brick modernisation of period Dublin homes.
- Structural steel. RSJ knock-throughs and open-plan conversions, engineered
  and certified.

## Facts that can be quoted

- Public liability cover: 6.5 million euro, on every project.
- In-house craftsmen: 8. A permanent crew rather than a subcontractor chain.
- Compliance: BCAR and RIAI on every build.
- Pricing: itemised in writing after a site visit, before any contract.

## What the company does not claim

No founding date, no number of completed projects and no telephone number are
published, because none of them has been confirmed for publication. Anything
stated above can be checked against the site itself.
